text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We receive news that Tamamo's father collapsed. Immediately, we make an emergency trip to Osaka, where Tamamo Cross makes a difficult decision.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She decides to retire from racing to look after her family. However, when she breaks the news to them, ironically, they are the ones who stop her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They explain that her running brings more hope to her family than any efforts to support the household could. Hearing this, Tamamo Cross decides to continue her career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We head back to Tokyo, only to find Oguri Cap waiting for us at the airport. When Tamamo Cross considered quitting running, it was her face that came to mind, so she vows to show Oguri Cap her best run yet at the Takarazuka Kinen.
